sections_checked: Appendix A Background and Related Work

recommendations: Keep the thesis's Reflexion → ExpeL and Reflexion/ReAct → Voyager lineage: these edges are repeatedly explicit in the primary papers and include method inheritance or direct comparisons.

Add Dynamic Cheatsheet at least as a substantive supporting predecessor to ACE. ACE explicitly says its generator/reflector/curator architecture is inspired by Dynamic Cheatsheet and tests it as the main online baseline. Primary inspection of /tmp/jc-memory-audit/2025-dynamic-cheatsheet.pdf (§2, especially §§2.1–2.2) shows a non-parametric memory that curates compact reusable strategies after each query (DC-Cu) or retrieves prior cases and synthesizes memory before answering (DC-RS). Its own limitations (§§4.5–5) are dependence on a capable base model, sensitivity to task similarity and order, erroneous-memory amplification, retrieval noise, and sequential scaling. This supports mechanism lineage, not a broad claim that curated memory reliably improves all models or task streams.

Use A-MEM in a bounded mechanism note rather than as a broad empirical anchor. Primary inspection of /tmp/jc-memory-audit/2025-a-mem.pdf (§§3.1–3.4) verifies atomic structured notes, embedding-filtered link generation, LLM-driven updates to nearby notes, and linked retrieval. Its limitations (§6) acknowledge dependence on the underlying LLM and text-only evaluation. ACE borrows the memory-entry analogy; MemSkill and SelfMem provide the more consequential direct comparisons against A-MEM.
Keep the WikiSkill trio together: its v1 introduction and Table 1 explicitly name and reproduce EvoSkill, Trace2Skill, and SkillOpt. Do not reverse these edges.

Use Trace2Skill v5's ReasoningBank and EvoSkill comparisons with their qualifications: ReasoningBank is re-instantiated under a shared trace pool, and EvoSkill is a full-system appendix comparison that the authors themselves call confounded relative to their component ablations.
SkillOpt v2 supports edges to Trace2Skill, EvoSkill, GEPA, and TextGrad only. Remove SkillOpt → WikiSkill from any aggregate or thesis language.
limits: All 14 seeds were inspected in full primary PDFs. Eight use retained local PDFs; Voyager, ReasoningBank, MemRL, SkillOpt, Dynamic Cheatsheet, and A-MEM were retrieved to /tmp/jc-memory-audit for this audit and are not retained in the repository.

Cited works with null cited_key are not present as exact families in research/sources.json; their identities were resolved from the seed bibliography and canonical primary URL rather than assigned invented keys.
This is a selective prominent-edge audit, not an exhaustive bibliography transcription or citation-frequency ranking.
